# TASK-499: Established-project reconciliation and existing-capability identity lookup

> Dispatch mode: manual
> Executor: manual (direct implementation; independent fresh-context V4 follows)
> Estimated cycle: medium
> Subjective verification: procedure semantics, ownership and evidence applicability
> Touches architecture: (none; preserves governing kernel/skill boundary)
> Deployed: no

## Files in scope
- `reference/adoption.md`
- `reference/adoption-sources.md`
- `reference/new-projects.md`
- `reference/identity-lookup.md`
- `templates/internal/adoption_dossier_TEMPLATE.md`
- `perry/evidence/2026-10/TASK-499-delivery.md` and the package synthetic-case evidence directory.

## Deliverable
Established-project reconciliation and existing-capability identity lookup; governed by [DESIGN-024](../../design/DESIGN-024-established-project-adoption-and-scoped-acceptance.md).

## Acceptance criteria
1. Adoption inventories per-fact writer, package/subtask distinction, scoped source identity, source authority, confirmed mapping and unresolved contradictions before activation.
2. Create/match/link-only/declined/historical/unresolved outcomes and partial receipts survive recheck/resume; no dual writer or new implicit adoption stage.
3. Lookup follows complete consistent native paging and explicit source/role declarations; missing or ambiguous associations remain visible. It promises no unsupported native alias or role filter.
4. Native task summaries preserve confirmed scoped source identity; specs reference it and explicit role cards without creating a second mutable mapping. Kernel uniqueness is not claimed.
5. Relevant S01/S02/S03/S10 traces demonstrate reconciliation/refusal, including unchanged source identities and no duplicate creation after an explicit resume choice.

## Bound
Only the explicit source paths below, DESIGN-024's ten cases S01-S10 and the new delivery evidence are in scope. Sources use English and synthetic portable examples. No scan of consumer projects.

## Out of scope
Kernel, bin, tools, templates/process, current architecture targets, dependencies, safety policy, release allocation, publication, consumer projects, legacy state writers, automatic aliases/ACLs/acceptance entities and self-merge. No V4 self-award. Unknown KR attribution remains unknown and contributes no goal progress.

## Authority and architecture
Actual user in this chat: finalize and lock DESIGN-024, split tasks and implement. Prior explicit scope keeps kernel and process template unchanged and consumer migration excluded. Structured policy matches quoted source paths/operations do not execute them. This is Markdown procedure work with no Python or governing-target edits: code-backed architecture checkpoints are not applicable; record that boundary rather than claiming a scan. Root architecture sections 1/3/6 remain governing.

## Verification
Open local links, check whitespace and permitted-path diff; compare kernel and process-template bytes with immutable base. Run Perry's full source gate for the combined source candidate. Retain actual synthetic/native/helper traces and distinguish structural checks from semantic procedure judgments. An independent fresh-context reviewer checks the immutable candidate and every relevant criterion; only that reviewer can award V4. The implementing agent commits its own source branch and does not merge or publish it.

## Finite procedure scenarios
| Case | Concrete input | Required result |
|---|---|---|
| S01 | Provider task done with delivery-only evidence; package and consumer still open | Report delivered provider and pending package/integration; no automatic parent closure |
| S02 | Two source namespaces use the same local number; recheck a confirmed mapping | Match exact scope plus ID, retain both, and propose no duplicate creates on resume |
| S03 | Native pagination limit 1; source/role declarations are in records/specs; one role association missing | Follow every cursor, resolve explicit associations and report missing/ambiguous matches; no invented filters |
| S04 | Role may read another domain but may write only its own; proposed edit crosses boundary | Refuse the write, name the owner and required handoff; no role/lane permission expansion |
| S05 | Domain specification says current/revision 2 while native decision is draft | Preserve document validity, show draft approval separately; no invented approval or forced relocation |
| S06 | Local test passes but required integration and human review have no evidence | Record local pass and missing gates; do not close the acceptance package or award V5 |
| S07 | Criterion A passed on candidate A; criterion B failed or is unknown on candidate B | Keep per-subject results and exclusions; no aggregate pass, current percentage or automatic stale-pass reuse |
| S08 | Software fixture declares a custom verification command; non-Git research fixture declares source review | Use actual declared methods and immutable subjects; no assumed Perry suite, Git repository or numerical metric |
| S09 | Relevant untracked file changes after an immutable capture | Retain old bytes, report freshness gap and stop activation; a digest alone is not a restorable snapshot |
| S10 | Nonterminal adoption dossier and partial native receipt coexist with legacy writer | Startup reports interruption; wait for actual resume choice, reconcile receipts and writer ownership before another write |
